name: Park Jae-Hyun
bio:
Park Jae-Hyun's journey in motorsport began unexpectedly, volunteering at a local karting track after a career in engineering. His technical acumen quickly became apparent, leading to roles in race engineering and vehicle dynamics. He joined CRG Racing Team ten years ago as a lead engineer, quickly rising through the ranks to become team principal. 

Park's approach is deeply rooted in data-driven decision-making. He believes in empowering his team through clear communication and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. His perfectionist tendencies drive him to relentlessly pursue marginal gains, focusing on optimizing every aspect of the team's performance, from pit stops to race strategy. He also takes pride in mentoring junior engineers and drivers, nurturing the next generation of motorsport talent.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: A man of medium build, Park often wears a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Drinks green tea obsessively throughout the day.
Has a habit of adjusting his glasses even when they're perfectly in place.
